title: Aggregation across a Guest’s Hotel Reservations
content:
Where a guest holds several reservations in the Hotel Rate Plans range that overlap in dates, the rate plans are not combined: each reservation is priced, taxed and penalised entirely on its own terms.

**The one aggregated figure.** The only figure aggregated across reservations is the guest's own room-night history, which decides whether the repeat-cancellation review is triggered and whether a goodwill gesture is within the desk's authority. A guest whose cancellations in the last twelve months exceed the review threshold of 4 is referred to the property desk before any further discretionary concession is given.

**Counted per room, never across the portfolio.** Occupancy limits, extra-occupant charges and cot or rollaway charges are counted per room and never across the portfolio. Club discounts and corporate rates are likewise applied reservation by reservation, and a discount earned on one reservation is never spread across another.

| Counted across the portfolio | Counted on one reservation alone |
| --- | --- |
| The guest's room-night history | Pricing, taxation and penalties |
| The guest's cancellations in the last twelve months | Occupancy limits and extra-occupant charges |
| | Cot and rollaway charges |
| | Club discounts and corporate rates |

*Boundary reading, hypothetical counts.* A guest with 4 cancellations in the last twelve months has not exceeded the threshold of 4; a guest with 5 has, and stands referred to the property desk before any further discretionary concession.
